hero.lead: I work in the team that runs IT for more than 60 hotels. I apply that method to your business and your website.

about.title: I'm Ángel, systems administrator and web developer.
about.p1: For the past 3 years I've been part of the systems team at an IT services company in Mallorca. We run the infrastructure of hotels, law and accounting firms, and businesses across many sectors. I look after servers, backups, remote desktops (RDS), networks and VLANs. A hotel can't stop, and if something breaks in the middle of the night the front desk still has to work.
about.p2: I bring that same way of working, with documentation, tested backups and planned changes, to freelancers, small businesses and new ventures, both for their IT and their website.
about.stackDaily: Every day I work with Windows Server, Active Directory, RDS, Hyper-V, Veeam, Fortinet, Next.js and Vercel.

services.title: Systems and web.
services.lead: Your IT and your website managed in one place. I support freelancers and growing businesses by simplifying all of their technology.
services.s1Lead: What I do for 60 hotels, scaled to your business. Servers, backups, network and support.
services.s2Lead: A simple website, ready in a week. I handle the domain, hosting and maintenance, plus a database if you need one.

process.title: How I work.
process.lead: From the first call to delivery, you always know where things stand.
process.s1Text: Free, no strings attached. You tell me what you need and we see if we're a good fit.
process.s2Text: I give you access to your own space. That's where the proposal arrives, and then where you follow the project, the files and anything I need from you.
process.s3Text: You see what I'll do, the timeline and the cost. If it works for you, you accept it with your online signature.
process.s4Text: I work in stages, and you can see at any moment where the project is.
process.s5Text: I hand everything over working and documented, so you know what's there and why.
process.s6Text: If something breaks, you open a ticket from your area and I handle it. With an hour bank if you need one.
